mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate reflects a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, resulting in lower S&P 500 valuations and negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months when FEDFUNDS is above its 5-year average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year inflation exceeds 8.0% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 8.0%), it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rates and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals an overheating economy and imminent aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), labor market weakness signals an impending economic slowdown, prompting the Federal Reserve to adopt accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of months when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A larger labor market, as measured by higher nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS), indicates robust economic activity and rising corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of months when PAYEMS is above its 5-year average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline below 1700.0 thousand units (HOUST < 1700.0), it signals weak consumer demand and an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of months when HOUST < 1700.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1700.0 thousand units and industrial production below its 2017 base (INDPRO < 100.0) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1700.0 and INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low industrial production regime (INDPRO < 100.0), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of months when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.
